primary.title: ITR forms out: Here's why salaried taxpayers should wait till 15 June instead of filing their income-tax returns now
primary.summary: The Income-Tax Department has released ITR 1-7 forms for FY26/AY27, including Excel utilities for forms 1 and 4 for offline preparation. Here's why experts advise salaried taxpayers to wait till June 15 to file their income tax returns…
